cards.title: What's going on in the body
cards.text: A paper reports that Gaucher disease happens because of a deficiency, meaning a shortage, of an enzyme called glucocerebrosidase, caused by changes in a gene called GBA1 [Ed85e96b, Ed3ff3f7]. A paper reports that doctors call this a lysosomal enzyme deficiency, where the lysosome, a tiny recycling part inside cells, is missing a working enzyme it needs [E309fa8a, E4cac688, E28eb929, E8ace403, Ed59ee48]. A paper reports that without enough of this enzyme, a fatty substance called glycosphingolipid builds up in the body instead of being cleared away [Ec8d1187, E96ea7eb, Eb29eb38]. According to HPO, children with Gaucher disease can have signs such as nosebleeds, eye changes, skin colour changes, a narrowed heart valve, low platelets that help blood clot, or low counts of blood cells [E593dee7, Ec2128b9, E34b3daa, E7953247, E7b9b951, Ef966bf9].

cards.title: Diseases that share the same biology
cards.text: According to HPO, Parkinson's disease that starts later in life is also linked to changes in the same GBA1 gene that causes Gaucher disease [Ede2b693]. A paper reports that in this form of Parkinson's, the same kind of lysosomal enzyme deficiency and fatty substance buildup can happen [Ece278e5, E8b12886]. A paper reports that Fabry disease is caused by a different gene called GLA, but it also involves a lysosomal enzyme deficiency and a buildup of fatty substances [E4b5796e, Ee0e2214]. According to Reactome, the GLA gene and the GBA1 gene both take part in the same glycosphingolipid breakdown pathway [Eaeb2dd9, E8a2d502]. A paper reports that Krabbe disease is caused by a different gene called GALC, but like Gaucher disease it involves a lysosomal enzyme deficiency and a buildup of fatty substances [E60744b8, E3f6bbf0]. According to Reactome, the GALC gene is also part of the same glycosphingolipid pathway as GBA1 [E6be1459, E8a2d502]. According to Reactome, the gene for GM2 AB variant, called GM2A, is part of the same glycosphingolipid pathway as GBA1 [Ee27a382, E8a2d502]. According to HPO, both Gaucher disease and GM2 AB variant are passed down in an autosomal recessive way, meaning a child needs a changed gene copy from both parents [E4180b6b, E0d47c11]. A paper reports that MLD, also called metachromatic leukodystrophy, involves the same kind of lysosomal enzyme deficiency and fatty substance buildup as Gaucher disease, though it is caused by a different gene called ARSA [E2af53d8, E7470be0]. According to Reactome, the ARSA gene is part of the same glycosphingolipid pathway as GBA1 [Eb39398b, E8a2d502].

cards.title: Research, trials and groups that exist
cards.text: According to ClinicalTrials.gov, there is a study called Natural History of Glycosphingolipid Storage Disorders and Glycoprotein Disorders that is recruiting in the United States and includes Gaucher disease [E750208f, Ed665e20]. According to ClinicalTrials.gov, a trial testing a medicine called Velaglucerase beta for children with Gaucher disease is being planned with a site in China [Ec46e2f8, Ef0d3d60, E1449560]. According to ClinicalTrials.gov, other Gaucher-related studies include a survey about home infusion education for a Gaucher medicine and a study on nutrition in people with Gaucher disease [E0c91255, Ea2d7818]. According to the NIH's RePORTER database, several National Institutes of Health programmes, including NCATS, NIDDK, NIGMS and NINDS, have funded research grants about Gaucher disease [E107bacb, E071543e, E94fa941, Ee9bdefc, Eea9353e, E3bc9616, E839fdc8, E6e9a867]. Many patient groups around the world list Gaucher disease as their focus, including groups in the United Kingdom, Spain, Italy and the United States, according to their websites [E422405d, E69bcb65, Edf446f8, E086c924]. According to ClinicalTrials.gov, there are also trials for the related condition Parkinson's disease linked to GBA1, such as one testing a therapy called PR001, and trials for Fabry disease testing treatments such as AMT-191 and migalastat [E709971f, Ec26ea35, E51e1c00, Ea2c0813, Ee204e48].

cards.title: Possible next steps
cards.text: A good first step could be to contact Gaucher patient groups such as the MPS Society in the United Kingdom, which the atlas links to Gaucher disease [E040d968, E9ff813a, E6ed20fd]. You could also contact AEEFE Gaucher, the Asociación Española de Enfermos y Familiares de la Enfermedad, or Asociación MPS-Lisosomales España, patient groups in Spain that the atlas links to Gaucher disease [E4099fdd, E69bcb65, Ed1d0a38]. Krabbe disease already has a global patient registry; it may be worth asking Gaucher organisations whether something similar could include or be copied for Gaucher disease [E92ff8aa].
